text: Serrano Speciality Hospital shows full payout concentration into one account over 76 claims and twenty doctors, with referrals spread thin and a 1.6-year registration. Twenty practising doctors is the opposite of a ghost roster, and no inflow concentration exists, so only the payout signal remains - hence the low band. Centralized payment processing across a large roster is standard practice for hospital groups. The signal is retained because payout hubs occasionally connect otherwise unrelated flagged entities.
